verses.19:90: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلۡجِبَالُ هَدًّا

meaning: The root هدد (hdd) primarily means to demolish, pull down, or destroy something, often with force or violence. It can also refer to a loud, rumbling sound, like thunder or a collapsing building.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
